title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Internal Appeal Interest Rate Card by Claim Age
content:
**Rate card — interest on internal appeals filed by Halverson Clinical Laboratories with contracted commercial plans, Insurance Coverage & Claims.**

The internal appeal's annual interest rate follows the age of the claim, counted in calendar days from its filing date to today:

| Age of the claim | Annual interest rate |
|---|---|
| More than 90 days (the aged claim days) | 18 percent (aged claim rate) |
| More than 45 days but not more than 90 days (the standing claim days) | 12 percent (standing claim rate) |
| 45 days or fewer | 8 percent (base claim rate) |

The annual interest rate is the yearly rate at which interest on the internal appeal's plan portion is figured.

## Boundaries

| Age in days | Rate |
|---|---|
| 91 | 18 percent |
| 90 | 12 percent |
| 46 | 12 percent |
| 45 | 8 percent |

## Rate questions

- **To what date is the age counted?** To today, from the claim's filing date.
- **Is the rate a yearly rate?** Yes. A hypothetical claim filed 120 days ago carries 18 percent a year; one filed 60 days ago, 12 percent; one filed 20 days ago, 8 percent.
